jobs.title: Senior Devops Engineer - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
**Job Title**


Sr. Devops Engineer, Senior Associate

**Role Summary \& Role Description**


We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our agile team. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products, with a focus on Devop practice


Candidate must have 4\+ years of relevant experience in Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure


Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Harness


Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployments using Kubernetes and Helm


Develop and manage infrastructure using Terraform / Terraform Enterprise (TFE)


Automate build, deployment, and release processes for multiple environments


Ensure platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security


Integrate security and compliance tools such as BlackDuck and Veracode into CI/CD pipelines


Collaborate with development, QA, and security teams to support application delivery


Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and runtime issues


Create and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks

**Core/Must have skills**


Good knowledge in Devops concepts and different CI/CD tools like Azure Devops and Harness


Strong experience in Kubernetes(AKS), IAC using Terraform/Terraform enterprise


Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure services


CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, Harness


Container technologies: Docker


Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm


Infrastructure as Code: Terraform / Terraform Enterprise (TFE)

**Good to have skills**


Good knowledge on Azure Databricks,Snowflake,Python scription.

**Work Schedule**


On\-premise / Hybrid

**Keywords (If any)**


Devops, Azure and Terraform

**Why this role is important to us**


Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.


We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

**About State Street**
======================


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
**Management Level:** 05 \- Associate Director Performance Marketing
  
  

**Location:** Hyderabad, Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore
  
  

**Must have skills:** Performance Marketing Strategy, Digital Campaign Management, Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads), Marketing Analytics, Lead Generation, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Marketing Automation, CRM Integration (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho), Budget Management, Funnel Optimization
  
  

**Good to have skills:** P\&L Management, Marketing Attribution, SEO/SEM, Account\-Based Marketing (ABM), A/B Testing, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Data Visualization \& Reporting
  
  

**Experience:** 15\+ years of experience is required
  
  

**Educational Qualification:** Master's degree Preferred
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

The Associate Director \- Performance Marketing will lead the performance marketing strategy and execution for programs, driving learner acquisition, enrollment growth, and marketing ROI across India. This senior leadership role combines strategic planning, digital marketing expertise, data\-driven decision\-making, and team leadership to scale demand generation efforts. The role requires building a high\-performing marketing function, optimizing the learner acquisition funnel, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to maximize business impact.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop and execute the national performance marketing strategy for programs, aligned with business objectives, enrollment goals, and revenue targets
  
  

Own end\-to\-end digital acquisition efforts, including paid media, lead generation, campaign optimization, conversion tracking, and marketing performance management
  
  

Drive qualified lead generation and maximize enrollment conversions through data\-driven marketing initiatives
  
  

Manage and optimize multi\-channel campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, display networks, affiliates, and other digital platforms
  
  

Lead, mentor, and guide a high\-performing performance marketing team, including campaign managers, analysts, and agency partners
  
  

Collaborate with Sales, Program, Product, and Content teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and learner engagement
  
  

Analyze campaign performance, market trends, competitor activities, and learner behavior to continuously optimize acquisition strategies
  
  

Ensure marketing excellence through robust analytics, attribution models, budget optimization, forecasting, and reporting for senior leadership
  
  

Drive process improvements, marketing automation initiatives, standard operating procedures, and best practices within the performance marketing function
  
  

Required Experience, Skills, and Qualifications
  
  

Graduate with 15\+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within higher education, EdTech, or B2C learning programs (MBA preferred)
  
  

Prior experience in the EdTech industry required
  
  

Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition, optimizing marketing spend, and driving significant enrollment growth
  
  

Strong expertise in paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization
  
  

Experience managing large marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI
  
  

Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, web analytics platforms, and marketing technology ecosystems
  
  

About Us
  
  

Backed by a $1 billion investment over three years, Accenture launched its LearnVantage business in March 2024, providing comprehensive learning and training services to help organizations reskill and upskill their people and achieve greater business results in the AI economy. Powered by an AI\-native platform, Accenture LearnVantage offers learning strategy and design, personalized learning experiences, learning managed services and certifications, all supported by a robust partner network and access to more than 2,000 mentors around the world.
  
  

For more information, please visit www.accenture.com/learnvantage.

-----------------

jobs.description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Materials Product Manager leads the development and management of a portfolio of Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Analytical Reference Materials, and Certified Reference Materials. This role is focused on execution of USP goals to deliver quality products across the Materials portfolio. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data\-driven and analytic decision making and making customer\-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross\-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high\-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.

* At least two (2\) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools

jobs.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our digital products. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and customer needs, ensuring that product investments deliver measurable business value while creating exceptional user experiences.  Domain \- Cybersecurity · AI\-Native Platforms · SaaS
   

  

 ABOUT NOPAL CYBER
   

  

 Nopal Cyber is building the next generation of AI\-native cybersecurity platforms, empowering organizations to detect, respond to, and neutralize threats with unprecedented speed and precision. Our flagship products, the N360 Web Application and Nopal Go Mobile App, form an integrated service delivery ecosystem trusted by security teams across industries.
   

 As we scale our platform capabilities, we are looking for a seasoned Product Development Manager who can bridge deep technical expertise with cybersecurity domain knowledge to drive end\-to\-end product delivery.
   

  

 ROLE OVERVIEW
   

  

 The Product Development Manager will own the full product development lifecycle for Nopal Cyber's AI\-native service delivery platform. You will lead a sizeable team of full stack and AI engineers across the N360 web platform and Nopal Go mobile application, ensuring seamless delivery of secure, scalable, and intelligent features built on a MERN stack deployed on AWS infrastructure.
   

 This is a high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of engineering leadership, product strategy, and cybersecurity service delivery, demanding someone who can architect solutions as comfortably as they can roadmap and lead people.

 Cybersecurity \& Compliance
   

 » Integrate cybersecurity best practices into every stage of the SDLC including threat modelling, secure code review, Secure SDLC and penetration testing.
   

 » Ensure platform adherence to relevant compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GDPR, EU Act as applicable).
   

 » Collaborate with the service delivery operations team to embed real\-world threat intelligence into platform feature development.
   

 » Evaluate and incorporate AI/ML\-driven security capabilities : AI incident response, AI attack surface management, AI\-native service delivery operations, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Delivery Management

 » Manage third\-party vendor relationships, open\-source integrations, and API partnerships where relevant.
   

  

  

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
   

  

 » 10\-12 years of software development experience, with at least 3\-5 years in a product/engineering management or technical lead role.
   

 » Proven track record managing agile engineering teams of 8\+ developers through full product delivery cycles.
   

 » Strong hands\-on proficiency with MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) — capable of reviewing architecture and code with authority.

jobs.title: Launch Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description and Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Launch Manager to lead strategic product launches across our Generics and Consumer Health portfolio.
   

  

 You will take full ownership of the launch lifecycle, from planning to execution to closure, ensuring that launches are delivered on time, aligned with business decisions, and optimized for value.
   

  

 As the leader of cross\-functional and multicultural launch teams, you will drive collaboration, challenge assumptions across stakeholders.
   

  

 You will navigate complex tasks with your launch teams, proactively seeking out data, and driving solutions without relying on step\-by\-step instructions.
   

  

* Leading cross\-functional launch teams, ensuring alignment and collaboration across all functions.
* Leading scenario planning and development of contingency plans to proactively address potential risks, delays, or shifts in market conditions, ensuring the team is prepared to adapt and respond effectively.
* Identifying the optimal momentum to launch. Creating ambitious and realistic timelines and overseeing the entire launch process.
* Ensuring achievement of business objectives, evaluating the business case/ profitability throughout the launch. Preparing a recommendation for decision making, if there are signs that the objectives may not be met, including coordinating a no launch decision when necessary.
* Ensuring that launch status and launch related information are up to date in internal systems. Maintaining active oversight of all launch\-related information, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
* Acting as the primary communicator of the launch view, proactively addressing and resolving critical issues.
* Preparing and presenting proposals for launch\-related business decisions to senior management.
* Ensuring timely and accurate reporting of launch progress and escalating issues as per internal guidance and requests.


**Primary Skills (essential)**
* 10 \+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with experience in the Generics sector and with at least 8 years in launch management or project management.
* Good understanding of European regulatory processes and solid experience in collaborating with finished\-product suppliers (manufacturing partners).
* Experience in leading cross\-functional teams across diverse cultural and organizational contexts.
* Ability to understand the big picture and long\-term while balancing with details and short\-term priorities.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, challenge, and align stakeholders toward shared goals.
* Excellent networking and communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple, simultaneous launch cases/ projects with efficiency and strategic oversight.
* A proactive mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a willingness to continuously learn and adapt.
* The capability to thrive in complex, cross\-functional, and international environments, navigating ambiguity with confidence and clarity.
* Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to foster a constructive, solution\-oriented team environment.


**About Us**
 Orion Pharma is a globally operating Nordic pharmaceutical company – a builder of well\-being for over a hundred years.
   

  

 We’re home to more than 4,000 Orionees around the world, and we’re proud to be known as a responsible employer and a great place to work. At Orion Pharma, people are truly valued and trusted, encouraged to grow, and supported by a culture where every voice is heard. We appreciate each other, strive for excellence, and build the future.
   

  

 Together we develop, manufacture, and market human and veterinary pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients. Our extensive portfolio includes proprietary and generic medicines as well as consumer health products. The core therapy areas of our pharmaceutical R\&D are oncology and pain. Proprietary products developed by Orion Pharma are used to treat cancer, neurological diseases, respiratory diseases, and more.
   

  

 We offer careers with a clear purpose: empowering people to live their lives to the fullest.

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 Are you a team player? Are you curious to learn? Are you interested in working in meaningful projects? Do you want to work with cutting‑edge technology? Are you interested in being part of a team that is working to transform and do things differently? If so, LPL Financial is the place for you!
   

  

 LPL Financial (Nasdaq: LPLA) was founded on the principle that the firm should work for the advisor, and not the other way around. Today, LPL is a leader\* in the markets we serve, supporting more than 18,000 financial advisors, 800 institution‑based investment programs and 450 independent RIA firms nationwide. We are steadfast in our commitment to the advisor‑centered model and the belief that Americans deserve access to personalized guidance from a financial advisor. At LPL, independence means that advisors have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run their perfect practice. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors, so they can take care of their clients.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a Technical Product Manager (TPM) who can bridge business requirements, user experience, and technical execution for web and mobile frontend applications. This role requires strong Agile Scrum Master capabilities, deep business analysis skills, and the ability to work across frontend and backend teams to define clear, consumable API contracts and highly detailed product stories.

* Ensure Agile best practices are followed and continuously improved.
* Remove impediments and manage risks that affect delivery timelines.
* Promote transparency, collaboration, and accountability within the Agile team.


**Web \& Mobile Frontend Focus (Must Have)**
* Act as the primary product partner for frontend engineering teams (web and mobile).
* Work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, and QA to ensure intuitive and performant user experiences.
* Understand mobile (iOS/Android) and web application technical constraints and design considerations.
* Validate frontend functionality and ensure alignment with business and customer needs.


**API \& Backend Integration Ownership**
* Create detailed documentation for API integrations consumed by web and mobile frontend applications.
* Define and document API contracts by collaborating closely with backend engineers and system stakeholders.
* Ensure API contracts clearly specify request/response models, error handling, performance expectations, and versioning.
* Act as a translator between frontend and backend teams, ensuring shared understanding and smooth integration.
* Participate in API design discussions to identify dependencies, risks, and integration impacts early.


**Technical Story Writing \& Execution**
* Develop granular, technically detailed user stories that clearly communicate:
* Functional behavior
* Edge cases
* Integration points
* Technical constraints
* Ensure stories are written at a level that enables engineers to estimate and implement with minimal rework.
* Validate acceptance criteria through demos, testing, and sprint reviews.
* Proactively identify gaps, assumptions, and technical risks in requirements.

This role requires strong Agile Scrum Master capabilities, deep business analysis skills, and the ability to work across frontend and backend teams to define clear, consumable API contracts and highly detailed product stories.

**Product Manager – Founder’s Office** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad – In\-office
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years in Product Management
 



**Team:** 
 Founder’s Office
 



  





**About GrabOn** 




 GrabOn is an AI\-driven performance marketing ecosystem focused on accelerating brand growth.
 



 For over 12 years, we have built and operated a connected portfolio of consumer\-intent platforms, growth products, and AI\-led workflows that help more than 3,800 brands convert customer intent into measurable business outcomes.
 



 We are a bootstrapped, profitable, and agent\-native organisation. Our AI agents work across research, search rankings, content creation, campaign planning, revenue attribution, reporting, and rewards processing, while our teams guide strategy and make critical business decisions.
 



 Our portfolio includes:
 


* GrabOn
* GrabCash
* GrabShare
* RankDrive
* Alternatives.co



 Across our platforms, we have influenced over
 **$4\.8 billion in GMV** 
 , served more than
 **76 million lifetime users** 
 , and processed over
 **96 million transactions annually** 
 .
 



 We are now looking for a high\-ownership Product Manager to join the Founder’s Office and help build the next generation of products across our portfolio.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is not a traditional Product Management role.
 



 As a Product Manager in the Founder’s Office, you will own products and features end to end—from identifying an opportunity and defining the problem to driving execution, launching the solution, measuring performance, and planning the next iteration.
 



 You will work closely with design, engineering, business, and go\-to\-market teams. You will be responsible for deciding what should be built, why it matters, how it should be executed, and whether it has delivered the expected user and business outcomes.
 



 Since this role is part of the Founder’s Office, your responsibilities may extend across multiple products and business areas. You should be comfortable working with incomplete information, evolving priorities, and undefined problems.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving complex problems, and can independently convert ideas into shipped and measurable products.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Product Ideation and Strategy
 


* Identify new product opportunities across Inspirelabs’ portfolio.
* Evaluate and validate ideas based on user needs, market potential, and business objectives.
* Convert broad concepts into clear product strategies and actionable plans.
* Prioritise product initiatives based on impact, effort, urgency, and strategic relevance.



 Market and Competitor Research
 


* Continuously analyse market trends, competitors, customer behaviour, and emerging technologies.
* Identify gaps, differentiation opportunities, and potential areas for innovation.
* Use research insights to influence product decisions and positioning.



 Product Requirements and Documentation
 


* Prepare clear, detailed, and structured Product Requirement Documents.
* Define user journeys, use cases, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Ensure design and engineering teams have sufficient clarity to execute efficiently.



 Design Execution
 


* Work closely with the design team to translate product requirements into intuitive user experiences.
* Review wireframes, user flows, and final designs.
* Ensure that the final experience aligns with user needs and product objectives.



 Engineering Execution
 


* Partner with engineering teams throughout product development.
* Track timelines, dependencies, risks, and delivery progress.
* Resolve blockers and make practical trade\-off decisions when required.
* Ensure products and features are delivered on time and according to agreed specifications.



 Go\-to\-Market
 


* Develop and execute go\-to\-market plans for new products and features.
* Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and other relevant teams.
* Ensure internal stakeholders understand the product, target users, positioning, and launch plan.



 Cross\-functional Coordination
 


* Act as the central point of coordination between design, engineering, business, and leadership teams.
* Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, timelines, decisions, and expected outcomes.
* Communicate product updates clearly and proactively.



 Product Measurement and Iteration
 


* Define success metrics before launch.
* Monitor adoption, engagement, user feedback, and business impact after launch.
* Identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Use data and user insights to guide future product iterations.



 AI Fluency – Core Requirement
 



 Inspirelabs is an agent\-native organisation where AI is actively used in production across research, content, reporting, campaign optimisation, and operational workflows.
 



 AI fluency is therefore a mandatory requirement for this role.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor - Business Process SOX
jobs.description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team:**  



At Mattel, we create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Our Global Internal Audit team plays an important role in strengthening governance, risk management and internal controls across our worldwide operations.


As Mattel continues expanding its Internal Audit capabilities within the Mattel Technology \& Innovation Center (MTIC), we are seeking an experienced **Lead Auditor – Business Process SOX** to provide day\-to\-day operational leadership for our global SOX compliance program.


This role offers an opportunity to help shape a growing global audit organization while partnering with colleagues across the U.S., EMEA, LATAM and APAC

 **The Opportunity:**  

The Lead Auditor will serve as the operational lead for Business Process SOX testing executed from Hyderabad.


Unlike a traditional people manager, this individual will act as the team's technical leader—ensuring testing progresses according to plan, work is assigned appropriately, review notes are resolved quickly, and testing quality consistently meets Mattel's Internal Audit standards.


Working closely with the U.S.\-based Audit Managers, this role will be responsible for coordinating daily execution activities across multiple business cycles while providing coaching and technical guidance to staff auditors.

**What Your Impact Will Be:**

**SOX Program Leadership**

* Lead execution of Mattel's annual SOX Business Process testing program from Hyderabad.
* Coordinate day\-to\-day testing activities across multiple audit cycles.
* Monitor progress against the annual SOX plan and proactively identify execution risks.
* Drive timely completion of testing while maintaining high quality standards.
* Support annual planning, resource allocation and workload balancing.

**Technical Review**

* Perform detailed review of SOX testing workpapers before manager review.
* Ensure testing complies with PCAOB standards and Mattel Internal Audit methodology.
* Validate testing conclusions and supporting evidence.
* Challenge control execution where necessary and identify testing gaps.
* Ensure consistent documentation quality across all business process areas.

**Team Leadership**

* Assign testing activities across staff auditors.
* Provide daily coaching and technical guidance.
* Support onboarding and development of new team members.
* Promote consistency in testing methodology and documentation.
* Share best practices across the team.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary operational contact for Business Process SOX testing activities.
* Coordinate walkthroughs with global process owners.
* Partner with Internal Audit Managers, control owners and external auditors.
* Escalate issues impacting delivery timelines or testing quality.
* Track remediation activities and support deficiency evaluation.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive standardization of audit documentation.
* Improve audit execution efficiency through automation and analytics.
* Support implementation of continuous monitoring capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through technology.
* Contribute to methodology enhancements and knowledge sharing.

 **What We’re Looking For:**

* We are looking for someone who combines strong technical SOX expertise with the ability to lead execution, mentor team members and drive operational excellence.


The ideal candidate enjoys being close to the work, solving problems, improving processes and helping others succeed.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or Business.
* 8–10\+ years of Internal Audit, External Audit or SOX Compliance experience.
* Significant experience testing Business Process SOX controls for multinational or SEC\-listed organizations.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ COSO Internal Control Framework
	+ PCAOB auditing standards
	+ SOX Sections 302 \& 404
	+ Risk assessment methodology
* Experience reviewing workpapers prepared by other auditors.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple concurrent audit engagements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPA, CA, CIA or equivalent certification.
* Big Four audit experience.
* Experience with AuditBoard / Optro, Workiva or other GRC platforms.
* Experience supporting external audit reliance.
* Exposure to SAP environments.
* Experience using data analytics or automation within SOX testing.

**Success in this Role**


Within your first year, you will:

* Become the operational lead for Business Process SOX testing executed from Hyderabad.
* Improve consistency and quality of audit documentation.
* Increase testing efficiency through better workload management.
* Reduce review cycle times through effective coaching.
* Build a high\-performing Business Process SOX delivery team.

**Leadership Behaviors**


The successful candidate demonstrates:

* Ownership and accountability
* Strong technical judgement
* Coaching mindset
* Attention to detail
* Continuous improvement orientation
* Effective stakeholder management
* Collaborative leadership
* Growth mindset

jobs.description:
The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data\-driven decision\-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.
 



  





 Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.
 



  





 The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.
 



  





 A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy\-by\-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.
 



  





 As a key figure in a global, organizational\-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.
 



 The role contributes to the continuous improvement of the platform by identifying gaps, driving enhancements, and aligning platform evolution with broader strategic initiatives such as data mesh adoption, data governance, and cloud transformation.
 



  





 Working closely with delivery leads, architects, and business product owners, the Data Platform Product Owner ensures a clear and transparent roadmap, enabling high\-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that support both current operations and future growth.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  





**Vision \& Product Strategy** 



* Define and maintain a clear product vision for the platform, balancing innovation, scalability, and operational stability.
* Own and manage the Data Platform product roadmap and backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Monitor platform adoption and usage, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvements.

* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data product teams, and platform engineering.

* Champion the promotion of the platform across the business functions and advocate for its usage in upcoming analytics or data\-driven initiatives across domains.



  





**Operating Model \& Governance** 



* Define, implement, and continuously improve the platform operating model (delivery models, ownership, support).
* Establish and govern intake, prioritization, and demand management processes.
* Ensure transparency on capacity, trade\-offs, and prioritization decisions.



  





**Platform Standards \& Compliance** 



* Ensure adoption of platform standards, including data product frameworks, privacy\-by\-design, and governance requirements.
* Work with relevant teams to embed compliance and data ownership practices across all use cases.



  





**Collaboration with Engineering \& Architecture** 



* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reusable, and maintainable platform capabilities.
* Align platform evolution with enterprise architecture and long\-term technology strategy
* Contribute to identifying and prioritizing technical improvements and platform enhancements.



  





**Communication \& Reporting** 



* Provide clear and consistent communication to stakeholders and leadership.
* Share roadmap updates, delivery progress, risks, and key decisions.
* Ensure transparency and alignment across all platform\-related initiatives.

jobs.description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**About the team**
------------------



In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  

  

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------



The IT\&D Business Analyst – SAP Pricing is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and maintaining SAP Pricing processes across the global Order to Cash (O2C), Revenue Management, and Commercial Operations cycles. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and IT teams to ensure accurate pricing, stable system performance, adherence to commercial policies, and continuous process improvement. The position plays a key role in SAP ECC deployment, S/4HANA readiness, pricing enhancements, issue resolution, and global commercial transformation initiatives.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Support SAP SD Pricing processes across quotation, sales order, delivery, billing, and rebate/discount management.
* Work with Commercial, Sales, and Finance users to gather requirements, analyse pricing issues, and propose SAP best‑practice solutions.
* Configure pricing procedures, condition types, access sequences, condition records, surcharges, discounts, scales, tax‑relevant pricing elements, and relevant O2C settings.
* Support testing cycles including unit testing, integration testing, UAT, and cutover preparation for pricing deployments.
* Prepare functional specifications for pricing enhancements, reports, interfaces, outputs, and workflow improvements.
* Monitor integrations across MM (purchase pricing), FI (billing accounting), Vistex (if applicable), and Tax engines.
* Assist business teams during month‑end and quarter‑end activities such as price validation, rebate accruals, credit/debit note processing, and pricing\-related reconciliations.
* Resolve day‑to‑day operational issues related to pricing errors, incorrect condition records, billing price mismatches, credit notes, and customer pricing disputes.
* Collaborate with managed service providers to ensure timely incident resolution and SLA compliance.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring pricing issues and recommend permanent fixes.
* Ensure compliance with audit requirements, commercial policy controls, ITGC, ITAC, and internal control frameworks related to pricing.
* Maintain accurate documentation for pricing configuration, master data, process flows, and change logs.
* Work with SAP Security \& GRC teams for pricing role access, mitigating controls, and SoD checks involving O2C.
* Support pricing master data governance for condition records, customer‑specific pricing, material pricing, rebate agreements, and tax‑related pricing data.
* Recommend opportunities for automation, digitalization, and pricing workflow improvements.
* Support S/4HANA migration readiness activities and participate in pricing enhancements, global rollouts, and template changes.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in business, Commerce, Engineering, IT, or related field.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst [T500-27573]
jobs.description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 The Senior Business Analyst plays a central role in bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams across our terminal operations and logistics domain. Across our businesses, our applications run business\-critical processes — from order to cash, product inventory, and field operations to bulk\-liquid storage, handling, and distribution — and the quality of our requirements and analysis directly determines the success of our delivery.
 



  





 As a Senior BA, your primary focus will be on eliciting, structuring, and validating requirements across complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes. You will work closely with product owners, engineers, and operational business users to translate real\-world challenges into actionable specifications and well\-delivered solutions.
 



  





 We take Digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring and enable them with the required tools to work in a modern way. As we are further building up our engineering practice, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape the future of our ways of working and technology landscape.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 



* Lead requirements gathering workshops with stakeholders across terminal operations, logistics, and enterprise functions to surface objectives, pain points, and solution options.
* Produce high\-quality Business Requirement Specifications (BRS), Functional Specifications, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria in tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Act as the primary interface between business users and technology teams — managing ambiguity, resolving gaps, and keeping alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners to manage and refine the product backlog, supporting timely and prioritized sprint delivery.
* Perform impact analysis for proposed changes or enhancements, identifying gaps, customization requirements, and feasibility risks.
* Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring delivered solutions meet requirements and are production ready.
* Contribute to the design of reports, dashboards, and operational tooling in support of business decision\-making.
* Deliver end\-user training and provide hands\-on go\-live support for new deployments and enhancements.
* Apply domain knowledge of bulk\-liquid terminal operations — including storage, handling, distribution, and maintenance workflows — to challenge requirements and propose fit\-for\-purpose solutions.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Business Analyst, with a strong focus on Shipping, Logistics, or Terminal Management Systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full lifecycle business analysis — from discovery and requirements through to UAT and go\-live.
* Strong working knowledge of terminal operations, including storage, depot processes, and maintenance workflows.
* Proven experience in Agile project environments; skilled in writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing backlog activities.
* Experience with JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools for requirements and backlog management.
* Familiarity with ERP systems and experience in impact analysis and customization scoping.
* Relevant industry certification in shipping, logistics, or enterprise platforms is a strong advantage.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Ability to independently lead complex requirements gathering sessions and produce specification\-grade documentation.
* Confident facilitation of UAT with business users and structured capture of outcomes.
* Experience working across cross\-functional, globally distributed teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to translate complex operational situations into clear, workable requirements for technical teams.
* Strong communication skills — equally effective with senior stakeholders and engineering teams.

-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



The "3M" team (Migrate, Manage, Modernize) is redefining enterprise cloud adoption. Our team leads Google Cloud’s migration and modernization products, shifting the industry from legacy "lift\-and\-shift" approaches to AI\-driven, agentic transformation of customer workloads. By leveraging generative AI, we build intelligent systems that assess, modernize, and deploy enterprise workloads from on\-premises or other clouds directly to modern, cloud\-native architectures.

  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Role:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Product Management
 



**Location:** 
 Singapore / Bengaluru
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Accounting, AI/ML, B2B SaaS, Fintech
 



  





**About Company** 




 An early\-stage AI startup founded in 2025, based in Singapore and Bengaluru. The company is building an AI platform purpose\-built for independent accounting firms in North America.
 



 Its platform acts as a specialised junior accountant, automating routine tasks within a human\-in\-the\-loop model. Firms using the platform report productivity gains exceeding five times in targeted workflows.
 



 The company raised $6 million in seed funding in April 2026 and operates with a lean team of eight. It targets the $150 billion global accounting sector — a space still largely untouched by modern tooling.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We're looking for a Product Manager who sits at the intersection of US tax domain expertise and AI product thinking. You'll own the product roadmap for our core accounting workflows, work directly with CPA users to extract real pain points, and ship prototypes fast enough to bring to the next discovery call. This is a hands\-on, zero\-ambiguity role at a seed\-stage company where your output ships to real firms within weeks.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end product discovery with CPA firm users — map workflows, extract latent needs, and separate critical pain points from nice\-to\-haves
* Translate discovery findings into precise specs with clear data models, edge cases, and testable acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately
* Build demoable prototypes of new features within days of a discovery session using low\-code tools, prompt chains, or lightweight front\-ends
* Define and maintain the product roadmap for core tax and accounting workflows, prioritising ruthlessly against firm\-level ROI
* Participate in technical design discussions on agentic architectures, retrieval approaches, and API integration patterns — contributing meaningfully without being the engineer
* Act as the quality bar for AI output accuracy — catch hallucinated tax rules, misclassified entity types, or incorrect workflow logic before they reach users
* Manage stakeholder communication across founders, CPA firm partners, and enterprise clients — async\-first, no\-surprises updates that don't require a meeting to understand



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 3\+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS — with at least some exposure to accounting, tax, fintech, or financial workflows (CPA firm experience is a strong plus, not a strict requirement)
* Familiarity with CPA firm or financial services workflows — document collection, review cycles, compliance deadlines, or regulated data handling — either through direct experience or adjacent fintech products
* Daily power user of frontier AI tools (Claude, GPT\-4o, Cursor, v0, or Bolt) — uses them to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and spec writing
* Ability to write structured prompts and system instructions for AI agents — understands context windows, tool\-calling, and practical failure modes
* Demonstrated ability to build a demoable feature prototype within days using low\-code tools or prompt chains — not slides, a working demo
* Writes specs engineers don't have to decipher — clear data models, edge cases called out, acceptance criteria that can be tested
* Proven track record of running structured user discovery sessions and translating ambiguous feedback into prioritised, actionable requirements



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Direct experience at a CPA firm, tax software company (UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake, CCH Axcess), or fintech serving accountants
* Experience with workflow automation platforms — Zapier, Make, n8n, or Python\-based document parsing pipelines (OCR, structured extraction)
* Familiarity with IRS compliance constraints: PTIN/EFIN requirements, IRC §7216 data privacy, e\-filing deadlines, and audit trail expectations
* Experience working at a seed or Series A startup where you owned the full product lifecycle with minimal process overhead
* Ability to review PRs for conceptual correctness — not code style, but whether the implementation matches what was agreed to build



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct impact — your roadmap decisions ship to real CPA firms within weeks, not quarters
* Founder\-level access — work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founding team on product strategy and customer discovery
* The rare chance to define the product category for AI in independent accounting — a $150B sector that's still largely untouched by modern tooling

jobs.description:
**Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?** 




  





  





*AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.* 




  





*Do You Dream Big?* 




*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more.
 



  





 We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale \- following Data Mesh and Domain\-Driven Design principles.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat.
 



 Your main mission is to:
 


* Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams.
* Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous.
* Build our Integration\-as\-a\-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud\-native architectures



  





 You’ll work in a cross\-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* **Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* **Discovery \& User\-Centricity**
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* **Roadmap \& Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* **Middleware**
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).



  





**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.



  





**Strong skills in:** 



* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)** 



* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.
* Explicitly call out experience with legacy\-to\-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel\-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog.



  





*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!* 




*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

We are looking for a Product Manager to drive the evolution of Freight Tiger’s logistics and payments platform — powering freight invoicing, reconciliation, and payments across India’s largest supply chains. The ideal candidate has scaled platforms from 1x to 10x, understands the ground realities of loading/unloading operations, and brings deep empathy for the fleet owner and truck driver ecosystem. You’ll define the future of how logistics payments flow — from trip to cash — across shippers, transporters, and finance teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end FRM product roadmap — from invoicing to reconciliation and payments — aligning releases with strategic business goals and customer impact.
* Lead platform scalability initiatives, driving modularization, stability, and adoption across multiple shipper and transporter segments.
* Design and ship workflows that digitize and automate freight invoicing, charge computation, ledgering, and multi\-entity reconciliations.
* Solve for B2B payments inefficiencies by embedding finance capabilities such as early payment options, split settlements, fuel/insurance integrations, and credit flows into logistics operations.
* Map and optimize operational touchpoints in loading/unloading, trip closure, and document capture — ensuring real\-world reliability for fleet owners, drivers, and yard operators.
* Champion ecosystem users — transporters, fleet owners, finance controllers, and supply chain leaders — and design for their pain points around cash flow, compliance, and visibility.
* Integrate seamlessly with ERPs and financial systems (SAP, Oracle, Tally) and external partners (banks, NBFCs, payment gateways) to enable frictionless transactions.
* Leverage data and AI models to drive predictive matching, anomaly detection, and invoice validation to reduce manual reconciliation and exception handling.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with engineering, design, operations, and finance to deliver scalable, intuitive, and compliant solutions.
* Define and track success metrics — feature adoption, invoice accuracy, reconciliation turnaround, working capital efficiency, and platform NPS.
* Mentor junior PMs and lead multi\-functional squads, ensuring execution velocity and outcome alignment across teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2–4 years of product management experience, with at least 1\+ years in logistics, supply chain, or fintech/payments within a B2B SaaS or marketplace environment.
* Proven experience in scaling complex enterprise platforms — from early MVPs to widely adopted multi\-tenant systems.
* Deep understanding of freight operations — including trip creation, loading/unloading, dispatch, and ePOD workflows.
* Experience working with fleet owners, transporters, and driver networks, with appreciation for their digital adoption challenges.
* Strong understanding of invoicing, billing, reconciliation, and payments workflows (GST, TDS, e\-invoicing, etc.).
* Prior experience integrating with banking and ERP systems, enabling digital payments and automated settlements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to convert operational pain points into scalable digital solutions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across business, tech, and operations.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for execution and track record of shipping impactful, revenue\-driving products.


 Success in this role will mean:
   

  

* Platform adoption scaled across top logistics customers.
* Reduction in reconciliation and payment cycle times.
* Improved driver and transporter experience through simplified workflows.
* 10x growth in processed freight value via automation and embedded finance features.

Reporting into the Enterprise Data Management lead, the **D****ata Domain Lead (MM/ BP)**, governance, and operational excellence of Master Data Management (MDM) within assigned business domain.


The role acts as the **primary interface between business stakeholders, data governance, and technology teams**, ensuring that master data is trusted, governed, scalable, and aligned with enterprise strategy. The Domain Lead establishes strong data stewardship communities, leads data quality initiatives, and ensures effective implementation and continuous improvement of MDM processes, platforms, and governance frameworks.

* Own domain\-level master data governance, data quality, and process frameworks.

* Act as the primary escalation point for domain master data issues and improvement initiatives.

* Business Domain Leaders and Functional Stakeholders

* 8\+ years experience in Master Data Management, Data Governance, or Data Quality roles.
* MGD Functional Expertise

**Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent communication and conflict resolution capabilities.
* Analytical and structured problem\-solving approach.
* Strong quality and results orientation.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Kognitos**
------------------


Kognitos is the deterministic agentic AI platform for the enterprise. Our patented neurosymbolic architecture lets organizations automate finance, procurement, supply chain, and IT workflows in plain English: business rules are the executable code, every step runs exactly as written, and every action is logged and auditable. Zero hallucinations, full governance, production\-ready in days. Kognitos is backed by Khosla Ventures, Prosperity7, and Wipro Ventures, recognized by Gartner and ISG, and trusted by Fortune 500 operators including PepsiCo and Wipro.

**The Role**
------------


Every enterprise wants AI in its core operations. Almost none can trust it there. Finance, procurement, and supply chain run on processes where a hallucinated number or a skipped step is not a quirk, it is an audit finding. That trust gap is why most enterprise AI never leaves the pilot stage, and closing it is the problem Kognitos exists to solve.


A platform alone does not close the gap. People do. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you take Kognitos into the customer's reality: environments with fragmented data, undocumented business rules, compliance obligations, and workflow complexity no outsider understands. You embed with the customer, understand how the business actually works, reengineer the process, and bring it live in production. This is where enterprise AI stops being a promise and starts being an outcome.


You own the account from the first discovery call through go\-live, adoption, renewal, and growth. You are not a consultant who advises and hands off; you build the solution, drive it to outcome, stay accountable for the value it creates, and carry what you learn back into the product.


The best FDEs operate across four dimensions: technical, functional, project management, and relationship. Few roles ask for all four, and fewer still let you build all four at once. This one does.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own enterprise accounts end to end: discovery, design, build, go\-live, adoption, renewals, and expansion. You are accountable for the health metrics of your accounts, NPS, adoption, time\-to\-value, and retention, not just project completion.
* Run process discovery and reengineering workshops with customers: map how the business actually works, diagnose the real bottleneck behind the stated request, and redesign processes rather than paving over them with automation.
* Design and build production automations on the Kognitos platform across finance, manufacturing, and logistics processes, integrating with ERPs and enterprise systems in environments where AI governance is still being defined.
* Act as the customer's trusted advisor: lead value\-based discussions with stakeholders from process owners to the C\-suite, set expectations honestly, and anchor every conversation in business outcomes.
* Drive customer success, evangelism, and growth: build champions inside the account, surface expansion opportunities, and own the commercial health of your accounts alongside the technical delivery.
* Manage multiple concurrent engagements, sequencing work to deadlines, holding the line against scope creep, and coordinating across two organizations.
* Feed field learnings back to Product and Engineering; you are our eyes and ears in the customer's reality.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We hire for demonstrated ability, not credentials. No certification, degree, or year count substitutes for showing us a problem you owned from first conversation to production. If you can walk us through something you have built, a process you redesigned, and an outcome you were personally on the hook for, that carries the interview.

### **What Actually Matters**

* Critical thinking and systems design: you can take a messy, ambiguous business problem and devise a system that solves it, not just execute a spec someone hands you.
* You think fast on your feet and run multiple threads at once: different accounts, different domains, different stages, without letting anything drop.
* You understand business context and pain deeply, and you translate it into a working technical solution. This translation is the core skill of the role.
* Strong working knowledge of how modern AI systems operate: LLMs, agents, prompt design, their failure modes, and where human\-in\-the\-loop belongs. And daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in your own work; not awareness, actual habit.
* Domain knowledge in Finance \& Accounting: AP/AR, invoicing, reconciliation, reporting, and close processes. Exposure to manufacturing or logistics operations is a plus.
* Customer leadership: running discovery and reengineering workshops, driving adoption and evangelism, leading value\-based discussions, and operating as the trusted advisor who owns the account through renewals and growth.
* Ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity. When something is broken or stuck, your instinct is to step in. Vague problems energize you rather than paralyze you.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; half this job is translating between the technical and business worlds.

### **Helpful, Not Mandatory**


Everything below strengthens your case but nothing here is a gate. We would rather hire someone who has shipped one real system end to end than someone with every logo on this list.

* Automation and RPA platforms: UiPath, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere, Workato, or similar.
* Enterprise systems: ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite; experience integrating against enterprise APIs and identity systems.
* Python or scripting, and familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
* Prior experience in Professional Services, Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Customer Success at enterprise software or AI companies.
