**ABOUT UNILEVER**  

With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.  

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

**ABOUT GDT:**


GDT is the global digital and technology engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. GDT serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

**About Us:**  

Wild are on a mission to remove single\-use plastic from the bathroom, armed with our refillable, natural and scent\-sational deodorants, body wash, and lip balm – and we’re only just getting started. We launched in 2020 and as a high\-growth company we’re already one of Europe’s fastest growing start\-ups.

 **Role Summary:**  

Scaling autonomous agents introduces a new and fast\-moving cost dynamic on top of Wild's growing cloud estate: token consumption and model selection sit alongside compute, storage, networking, and data\-processing spend that can all escalate quickly if left ungoverned. The FinOps Manager (AI \& Token Economics Focus) owns the financial discipline behind Wild's cloud and AI transformation — ensuring the GCP environment and every agent workload run cost\-efficiently, transparently, and deliver measurable ROI at scale.  

This role blends cloud infrastructure financial management with deep AI\-specific cost expertise. You will track and manage consumption across the full GCP services footprint — compute, storage, networking, data/BigQuery, and AI/Agent Builder — as well as Snowflake credits, building clear visibility into where spend goes by service, model, agent, team, and use case. You will own cloud budgets and guardrails, drive infrastructure optimisation (rightsizing, autoscaling, committed\-use discounts), and partner with engineering to tune both infrastructure utilisation and token usage. You translate technical activity into business economics — cost per task, cost per outcome, and value realised.  

You are the team's commercial conscience and the owner of Wild's FinOps practice. As Wild moves from experimentation to a growing, always\-on cloud and agent portfolio, you establish the processes, tooling, KPIs, and cost\-accountability culture that keep investment decisions evidence\-based, infrastructure and AI spend predictable, and the platform delivering a clear, defensible return.

 **Key Responsibilities**  

* Establish and run Wild's FinOps practice hands\-on — processes, tooling, KPIs, and a cost\-accountability culture — personally owning day\-to\-day cost tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
* Track and manage cloud consumption across the full GCP services footprint — compute, storage, networking, data/BigQuery, and AI/Agent Builder — alongside Snowflake credit usage and AI token consumption.
* Own GCP cloud billing and cost management: billing accounts, budgets and alerts, billing/BigQuery exports, resource labelling/tagging, and a clean cost\-allocation hierarchy across projects and environments.
* Deliver cost visibility and reporting using native GCP tooling and third\-party FinOps/cost\-management platforms (e.g. Cloudability\-class tools) — dashboards of actual vs. budget, spend drivers, and usage peaks that are relevant, meaningful, and actionable.
* Drive cloud infrastructure cost optimisation: rightsizing, autoscaling, scheduling, idle/orphaned\-resource cleanup, storage tiering, and committed\-use / sustained\-use discounts and reservations — partnering with Cloud Operations and engineering on implementation.
* Govern token economics: monitor token consumption, model usage, and unit costs; identify and drive AI\-specific optimisation opportunities.
* Manage GCP commitment and contract economics: monitor and report committed\-spend thresholds against agreements, drive burn\-down of enterprise commitments, and evaluate cloud marketplace procurement to achieve lower unit pricing.
* Build financial models and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for services, agents, and major cloud workloads; produce forecasts that account for planned changes and new workloads.
* Run chargeback/showback: calculate the monthly/quarterly costs allocated back to teams and business units, reconciled with Finance through agreed financial processes.
* Define and report ROI: cost per task/outcome, value realised, and payback for each agent use case and major cloud workload.
* Define, measure, and track FinOps KPIs at practice and service level.
* Detect anomalies and prevent runaway spend across infrastructure and AI through alerting, guardrails, and tagging\-compliance reporting.
* Partner with and enable business and engineering teams on managing cloud and AI spend, and surface cost\-value analysis to inform investment prioritisation.


Required Skills \& Experience

jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.


We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager to own the Audit \& History product area—a critical pillar of Smartsheet's enterprise platform. This role is responsible for delivering capabilities that help our largest customers understand, track, and recover from every meaningful change—human or AI—that happens inside their Smartsheet environment. The product area spans platform\-level audit and observability, sheet and data\-level history, and emerging unified access experiences, and is core to how enterprise customers build trust in Smartsheet.



You will act as the leading voice for Audit \& History, collaborating closely with engineering, UX, security, GTM, and Customer Success teams to deliver solutions that build customer trust, accelerate enterprise adoption, and protect the integrity of work that runs on Smartsheet. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on individual contributor role for a product thinker who is customer\-obsessed, deeply technical, and passionate about solving complex platform observability and data lifecycle problems at enterprise scale.


**You Will:**


* Own and drive the execution roadmap for the Audit \& History product area, including platform\-level audit logging, sheet and data\-level history, restoration workflows, and emerging unified access and observability experiences
* Serve as the product owner across multiple, technically interdependent engineering teams, making clear scoping and sequencing decisions on features that often carry infrastructure and architectural implications
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas—SysAdmins, compliance officers, security and IT leaders, and PMO owners—to surface signal, validate assumptions, and pressure\-test designs before they ship
* Author crisp product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity, from early discovery through to GA and post\-launch iteration
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across UX research, design, GTM, Customer Success, and data and analytics teams to move features from concept to GA and adoption
* Represent the Audit \& History product area in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer\-facing conversations, including enterprise account escalations and executive briefings
* Partner with engineering on\-call and support teams to triage and prioritise customer\-impacting production issues in the Audit \& History space
* Define success metrics for every feature you ship and partner with data and analytics teams to ensure proper instrumentation, dashboards, and reporting from day one
* Contribute to pricing and packaging decisions for new and existing Audit \& History capabilities, working alongside pricing, sales, and GTM to position offerings effectively
* Collaborate effectively with engineering and design team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaborative product delivery
* Perform other duties as assigned


**You Have:**


* 5\+ years of product management experience, including delivering impactful enterprise SaaS or B2B software solutions

jobs.description:
**About the Role** 






 We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to own what we build and how it ships. You will own the product and feature roadmap, keep quality high by reviewing pull requests for standards and compliance, run the testing cycle, and shepherd every feature to a clean go\-live.
 
  
 




 This is a delivery and ownership role, not a hands\-on coding role — you won’t be writing features day to day. But you must be technical enough to read code, judge whether a change meets our standards, and hold a confident conversation with developers and QA. You are the person who makes sure the right things ship, and that they ship well.
 
  
 



**What You’ll Do** 






 •
 

 Own and maintain the product and feature roadmap; turn business needs into clear specs and user stories
 





 •
 

 Prioritise features and manage the backlog with stakeholders.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Review pull requests for standards and compliance — tests present, conventions followed, tickets linked — and route issues back to developers.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Plan and manage the test cycle — test plans, regression, and UAT.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Coordinate and own go\-lives and releases, including checklists and rollback readiness.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Work closely with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to keep delivery on track.
 
  
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 






 •
 
**4\-5 years in a product, delivery, with enough technical background to read code and judge whether a change meets standards.** 






 •
 

 Experience owning a product or feature roadmap: requirements, prioritisation, and specs.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience reviewing work for quality and compliance (PRs, test coverage, standards).
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience planning and managing a testing / QA cycle.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience managing releases and go\-lives, including rollback planning.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Strong communication and coordination across developers, QA, and business.
 
  
 



  





**This Role Is Not a Fit If…** 






 •
 

 You are a pure project manager with no ability to read code or judge technical quality.
 
  
 




 •
 

 You have never owned a roadmap, a test cycle, or a release.
 
  
 




 •
 

 You need someone else to make every call on scope, quality, and go / no\-go.
 
  
 



  





**Nice to Have** 






 •
 

 Familiarity with our stack (Angular, Python, AWS).
 
  
 




  
 

 •
 

 Agile / Scrum experience.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Fluency with tools like Jira and GitHub pull requests.
 
  
 




 •
 

 A past hands\-on engineering or QA background you can point to.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Product Owner**
**BASIC SUMMARY:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely , high\-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI\-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Execution**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well\-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member
* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release


**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories
* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility
* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations


**Healthcare Domain Support**
* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features


**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business , Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2\+ years of product management experience ; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2\+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input (preferred but not required )
* Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints
* Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

 Has accountability for the performance and results of a team within own discipline or function
   

  





 Is recognised as an expert in own area within the organisation and has specialised depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or function
   

  





 Interprets internal or external issues and recommends solutions/best practices
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Job Description**




**Job Role**




 Product Owner \- IC4
   

  





**Location**




  

  





**Reporting to**




 Product Owner Manager
   

  





**Business Unit**




 Product
   

  





**Level**




 F
   

  





**Date**




  

  





**Brief Job Summary**




 The Product Owner works closely with the Product Manager to understand and deliver the strategic roadmap for the product. They will work with the development team and supporting roles to break that roadmap down into prioritised requirements. Working with support from the Product Manager they will ensure that the development team has a clear understanding of the product/platform vision and goals. They oversee product build progress, answering queries and helping solve impediments to the delivery. The role is part of our squad structure and can be aligned to any product or platform in SS, RS or Common Services.
   

  





**Roles and Responsibilities**



* Support the Product Manager with the creation and update of a centrally mastered Product Roadmap.
* Ensure the Product Roadmap is reflected correctly in our work management tooling (JIRA or ADO).
* Creation of features and user stories with support from other roles in the form of a healthy prioritised backlog.
* Definition of sprint goals to help focus the teams during their increment.
* Formal acceptance of work as done and ready for release.
* Support cross team dependency management.
* Input to both product and build reporting as required including financial reporting and budgeting.
* Use data to recommend to the Product Manager best solutions and approaches.
* Creation of technical user stories where required and ability to prioritise these.
* Plays an active role in agile and scaled agile events, supporting agile values and helping promote the continual improvement cycle through inspect \& adapt.
* Contribute to the product vision, goals, success measures and roadmap for the product.
* Applies some domain knowledge or demonstrates ability to quickly learn about the product(s), market and customer base.
* Understand what KPIs are most valuable to the business ensuring these are reflected in the product delivery.
* Support the Product Manager in Product Discovery through the elaboration of product features from the product roadmap ultimately reaching approval to build based on ROI.
* Work with the supporting roles and internal/external stakeholders to further refine approved product features through detailed requirements analysis/design to get work ready for planning \& build documented through user stories.
* Ensure Non Functional Requirements are being created, maintained and tested against.
* Work directly with Info Sec and or DPO on product change that need their approval to ensure the product is compliant

**Overview**
**Product Owner**
**Basic Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI\-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Execution**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well\-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member
* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release


**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories
* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility
* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations


**Healthcare Domain Support**
* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features


**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2\+ years of product management experience; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2\+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input (preferred but not required)
* Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints
* Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)

Office location – Cognizant Neon Facility
  
Business Analyst – Payments, Trade Finance, Cash Management \& Liquidity
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a detail\-oriented and domain\-savvy Business Analyst to support transformation initiatives in Payments (SWIFT, ISO 20022, real\-time, cross\-border), Trade Finance, and Cash Management \& Liquidity. The Business Analyst will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, solutions are aligned with business objectives, and regulatory compliance is maintained.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
  
Collaborate with business stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate requirements for payments, trade finance, and liquidity solutions.
  
Translate complex business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  
Conduct gap analysis between current processes and target state.
  
Payments Domain
  
Support initiatives in SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022 migration, real\-time payments, and cross\-border transactions.
  
Document workflows, data mapping, and compliance requirements for payment systems.
  
Assist in testing and validation of payment solutions.
  
Trade Finance
  
Analyze business processes related to trade finance instruments (letters of credit, guarantees, supply chain finance).
  
Support digitization and automation of trade finance operations.
  
Ensure solutions meet risk management and compliance standards.
  
Cash Management \& Liquidity
  
Gather requirements for corporate cash management, liquidity optimization, and treasury services.
  
Document processes for real\-time cash visibility and forecasting.
  
Support implementation of liquidity management tools.
  
Stakeholder Collaboration
  
Act as liaison between business units, technology teams, and external vendors.
  
Facilitate workshops, interviews, and requirement walkthroughs.
  
Ensure alignment of solutions with business goals and regulatory frameworks.
  
Risk \& Compliance
  
Ensure requirements adhere to regulatory frameworks (AML, KYC, PSD2, Basel III).
  
Identify risks in requirements and proactively propose mitigation strategies.
  
Support audit and governance processes with clear documentation.
  
Qualifications
  
7–10 years of experience as a Business Analyst in banking or financial services.
  
Strong knowledge of payments (SWIFT, ISO 20022, real\-time, cross\-border).
  
Experience in trade finance processes and instruments.
  
Familiarity with cash management, liquidity solutions, and treasury operations.
  
Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or Agile BA are a plus.
  
Key Competencies
  
Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
  
Ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements.
  
Deep understanding of financial products and regulatory frameworks.
  
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills.
  
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Train Reliability Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.


Could you be the full\-time Train Reliability Data Analyst in Bangalore we’re looking for?

  

**Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your data analysis and reliability expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside committed and collaborative teammates.



You'll contribute directly to improving the service reliability performance of our mobility solutions. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (after\-sales service, engineering, project management), summarize reports and service incidents/failures encountered on test trains and at our clients, and propose continuous improvement actions.



You’ll specifically take care of statistical analysis of fleet performance in service reliability and manage the CMMS database (reliability part) but also coordinate with different stakeholders.



We’ll look to you for:


* Feeding the Train Reliability Data Analysts with service reports to be analyzed.
* Preparing and presenting analyses of service incidents/failures during internal monitoring meetings.
* Defending Alstom's interests with stakeholders, including customers.
* Performing statistical analyses to monitor service reliability performance.
* Providing reliability analysis reports for internal teams and customers.
* Ensuring compliance with RAM Métier processes and instructions.
* Collaborating with various teams to ensure service reliability demonstration plan compliance.
* Proposing continuous improvement actions to optimize tools and processes.
* Delivering RAMS analyses compliant with QCD work package commitments.
* Proactively challenging RAMS data/results to enhance adequacy and consistency.
* Seeking technical understanding of Alstom products to better assess performance and improvement areas.
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* General technical and functional knowledge in the railway field (rolling stock). Training in RAMS competency will be provided.
* Skills in statistics and reliability measurement methods.
* 8 years' experience or understanding of database management and development tools (MS Office, SharePoint, etc.).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Customer and product orientation.
* Ability to structure and adopt practical approaches.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken).
* Strong time management skills.
* Sense of priorities.
* Structured and organized with a hands\-on approach.
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with passionate and innovative teams who share a common vision
* Collaborate with transverse teams and skilled colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects shaping the future of mobility
* Utilize our flexible and collaborative working environment
* Steer your career in the direction you choose across functions
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership roles or technical expertise positions
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  




You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Database, Project Manager, Sharepoint, Developer, Technology

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Job Title:** Business Systems Analyst


**Your opportunity:**



New Relic is looking for an experienced Business Systems Analyst to play an essential role in supporting our Global Technical Services organization (GTS). The primary focus of the role will be supporting ongoing strategic initiatives, systems enhancements, change requests, and permission requests while contributing to testing and change management in preparation for production releases in Salesforce.



The Business Systems Analyst will be part of the GTS Enterprise Systems team at New Relic, working side by side with the Program Manager, other Business Systems Analysts, and development teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.



As the Business Systems Analyst, you will handle enterprise aspects of our Salesforce Service Cloud platform. To be successful, you’ll need a deep understanding of Global Tech Support business processes and translate them into Service Cloud systems requirements, build effective solutions, and ensure the full adoption of the Service Cloud platform and integrations.


**What you’ll do:**


* Collaborate with Program Managers to translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and build\-ready specifications for engineering teams.
* Create visual system and process documentation such as wikis, flows, and wireframes to support all requirements.
* Partner with Engineering teams to scope and implement new Salesforce features, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical best practices.
* Own the end\-to\-end testing lifecycle, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), to ensure the quality and stability of all system enhancements prior to deployment.
* Design and implement performance metrics and reporting dashboards to track project ROI, system adoption, and the impact of build iterations.
* Drive change management and user enablement strategies, creating documentation and training resources to maximize platform adoption across the organization.
* Provide internal system support for Salesforce platforms, managing incoming requests and resolving operational issues to minimize downtime.
* Perform system administration, including user management, data hygiene, and configuration updates, to maintain optimal platform health and data integrity.
* Manage third\-party integrations (e.g., Sharefile, EzProtect, AWS Connect), ensuring seamless interoperability and consistent performance within the Salesforce ecosystem.


**Requirements for this role include:**


* 4\+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or equivalent role
* 3\+ years of hands\-on expertise with Salesforce platforms, including Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Agentforce
* At least 2 years of project management or analysis\-focused experience is highly preferred
* Deep business acumen regarding Technical Services and Support operations
* Proven capability in drafting comprehensive requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and business process documentation
* Exceptional skills in communication, critical thinking, problem\-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder management
* Demonstrated capability to articulate technical issues clearly and resolve problems across all organizational tiers
* Highly proficient at managing and balancing competing priorities effectively
* Practical experience working with Jira and participating in scrum events

  



Bonus points if you have:


* Salesforce Certified Business Analyst or other Salesforce certification preferred
* Experience building Salesforce testing automations
* Familiarity with Revenue Operations team structures and processes
* Familiarity with support entitlement structures

We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.



If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.



We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.


**Our hiring process**  

  

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Amazon Pharmacy
jobs.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Pharmacy India is seeking a creative, goal\-oriented, and analytically rigorous Business Analyst to join our growing team. Amazon Pharmacy is scaling rapidly in India with multiple new feature launches, partner integrations, and category expansions planned over the next two years. This role is critical to enabling data\-driven decision making across the business.
   

  

 This is both a strategic and hands\-on role. It requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, deep knowledge of business intelligence solutions, strong business acumen, and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, category, and operations teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Reporting \& Automation: Own complex reporting pipelines and automate reporting solutions to reduce manual effort and improve data freshness for category and business teams.
   

  

 Insight Generation: Analyze large, multi\-source datasets to surface actionable insights and key business drivers that inform product roadmap, selection strategy, and CX improvements.
   

  

 Forecasting \& Planning: Build and maintain forecasting models for product selection at node level, demand planning, and partner performance tracking.
   

  

 Data Triangulation: Integrate and reconcile data from multiple internal and external sources (3P partners across teleconsulting, prescription management, fulfillment, and health services) to create a unified, reliable view of business performance.
   

  

 Partner Data Enablement: Design and deliver seamless data visibility solutions for external partners, enabling them to access, interpret, and act on relevant business data.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, category, operations, CX) to define KPIs, align on metrics, and drive accountability through data.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
